g.text: Ink custody — the loop that cannot lose a stroke
Reports carry the ink · a save that lies is ink loss · the final report is enforced
the pass's exit is the single owner of re-arming — a still-dirty page re-enters at the debounce
Every teardown path ends the same way — enforced inside the runtime, not by host manners
final ink report (debug-traps if skipped) → custody already complete — there is nothing left to lose
Close is a final save pass over values the Document already holds — the draining-session concept, the isClosing window,
and the retire handover as a correctness event all cease to exist.
